rationale: ToolResultMessage<TDetails> is the single variant {role: "toolResult", ...}; Go ToolResultMessage has a field for every property (details is any, DetailsNull keeps an explicit null) and emits the role literal and exactly the upstream property names (wire test).
Message is the union of the system, user, assistant and tool-result messages; Go declares it as the closed interface implemented by exactly those four types (each variant row is closed).
